text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

You and the successful candidate are both women, so sex can't easily explain why she was preferred over you. An all-women panel is a fact about composition, not evidence of bias — and raising it would likely read as insinuation without a mechanism, undermining your credibility on stronger points.

Your real grounds are elsewhere. The decision weighted "client relationships" over years of design experience and project leadership — that may be a legitimate business judgement for a group-head role, or an unstated criterion applied late. If anything, age is the more coherent concern (forties versus a candidate with eight years), though eight years' experience alone proves nothing.

Focus on the unanswered request: send a written follow-up with a deadline, citing your earlier date.
